data.name: ExtensionDistinction
data.value: A Connected Service references a governed type resource. The type may be built in, user-authored or managed by an extension.

data.name: Empty.Message
data.value: Create an instance after a compatible Connected Service type resource is available.

data.name: Details.Description
data.value: Inspect the pinned type resource, safe configuration, exports and diagnostics.

data.name: NoBindings
data.value: No Literal, Parameter or Secret bindings are configured.

data.name: ContributionUnavailable
data.value: The pinned type revision is no longer available. Saved evidence remains visible; reconcile only after reviewing the changed contract.

data.name: NoExports
data.value: This type revision declares no exports.

data.name: DependentsExplanation
data.value: Storage and Data Source resources select this Connected Service explicitly. Their own pages remain responsible for provider-specific configuration.

data.name: ReconcileConfirm
data.value: Re-read the pinned type resource and reconcile this instance? Contract changes are never applied silently.

data.name: DeactivateConfirm
data.value: Deactivate this Connected Service? Consumers will no longer be able to resolve it.

data.name: ScopeRequired
data.value: An exact ownership scope is required.

data.name: Editor.Description
data.value: Configure one exact service type resource and bind its inputs explicitly.

data.name: ManualBindingExplanation
data.value: Enter a literal or select each Parameter or Secret explicitly. No extension-to-extension mapping is inferred.

data.name: NoTypes
data.value: No enabled Connected Service type resource is currently available.

data.name: TypePinnedHelp
data.value: The type resource UID, version and schema digest are pinned when the resource is created.

data.name: NoTypeDescription
data.value: No description was supplied for this type.

data.name: Bindings.Description
data.value: Standard inputs accept typed literals or exact scoped Parameters. String inputs may use Secrets, whose values are never displayed.

data.name: NoInputs
data.value: This type revision declares no external inputs.

data.name: ParameterBindingHelp
data.value: Only Parameters with the declared value type are offered.

data.name: SecretBindingHelp
data.value: The Secret value remains write-only and is resolved only by the backend.

data.name: NoDependents
data.value: No dependent resource currently reports this Connected Service.

data.name: YamlReadOnlyHelp
data.value: This manifest reflects the saved resource definition. Edit it through the Definition tab.

data.name: Discovery.Help
data.value: Discover operations from this saved Connected Service. Follow each discovery Flow Run and review its operations here.

data.name: Discovery.Unsupported
data.value: This service type revision does not currently provide a discovery Flow. Historical results remain available.

data.name: Discovery.Failed
data.value: The request could not complete. Check the service revision, access and execution history, then refresh or retry.

data.name: Discovery.Accepted
data.value: Discovery accepted. Open its Flow Run or refresh to follow completion.

data.name: Discovery.ActivationHelp
data.value: Enable or disable operations explicitly here. Activation does not execute an operation or publish a Tool. Existing Data Sources keep their saved operation revisions.

data.name: Discovery.NoOperations
data.value: No operations have been discovered for this service.

data.name: Discovery.NoHistory
data.value: No discoveries in the current execution context.

data.name: Http.DiscoveryHelp
data.value: The HTTP URL is an example used to discover one GET operation and its query parameters. Discovery sends no request. Example values are discarded; configure acquisition values independently on each Data Source. Repeated query parameter names are not supported.

data.name: Http.SampleUrlHelp
data.value: Enter the complete example HTTP(S) request URL, including its query parameters. Their values are used only as examples and are not copied to the operation or Data Source.

data.name: SchemaCandidate.Help
data.value: Inspect the pinned OpenAPI evidence and effective acquisition contract. Creating a draft neither publishes it nor changes a consumer. Publish explicitly, then adopt its exact version in a Data Source or collection.

data.name: SchemaCandidate.Unsupported
data.value: This candidate cannot be exported with the supported acquisition schema profile. Its original evidence remains available.

data.name: SchemaCandidate.Failed
data.value: The Schema draft could not be created. Check the name, permissions and supported schema constructs.

data.name: SchemaCandidate.Library
data.value: Inspect or reuse a published Schema
